en.text:
Passively grants 40 Airborne Effectiveness and 10 Draw Time Stat (equivalent of a Draw Time Masterwork) to Bows.

Full Draws grant 'Adamantine Brace':
• Allows Perfect Draws to be held indefinitely
• <pve Grants 37.5% increased damage against PVE Combatants for every 0.5 seconds you hold a perfect draw, up to a 200% increase />

PVE damage buff only affects the initial Impact damage (e.g. Wish Ender's overpenetration is unaffected) and expires after 4 seconds of Adamantine Brace being active.

<yellow Leviathan's Breath /> does not receive the damage increase.
